name: Volumetric Tree Reconstruction via Opacity Estimation and View-Dependent Texturing
aliases: Opacity Estimation and View-Dependent Texturing for Trees
definition: A method for reconstructing and rendering trees from photographs by estimating isotropic discrete opacity values on a recursive grid and rendering using view-dependent billboards to preserve high-frequency color details.
summary: This method reconstructs trees from photos by estimating opacity on a grid and generating view-dependent billboard textures to preserve high-frequency color details without blurring.
